meta.title: El Rincón de Gredos · Country house in Navaluenga, Ávila
meta.description: A stone retreat in the Sierra de Gredos. A charming country house in Navaluenga (Ávila): rooms with views, a fireplace and a hot tub. Book directly, with no fees.

hero.title: El Rincón de Gredos
hero.subtitle: A stone retreat where time slows right down.

about.title: Your home in the mountains
about.p1: El Rincón de Gredos is an old stone house, lovingly restored, right in the heart of the Sierra de Gredos. Century-old walls, wooden beams and clay-tiled floors sit alongside every modern comfort, so all you have to think about is resting.
about.p2: You can rent the whole house for your group or family, or book one of our three rooms. Either way, silence, nature and the scent of lavender from the garden are waiting for you.
about.hostQuote: Here you wake up with the mountain in the window and your coffee unhurried. I love welcoming people who are looking to truly switch off.
about.servicesSubtitle: Little touches to make you feel right at home.

rooms.title: Three rooms with soul
rooms.subtitle: Each room has its own character. Choose your favourite, or take the whole house.

serrana.name: La Serrana
serrana.description: Two beds and an original stone wall dressed with colourful handmade blankets. Bright and cosy, perfect for two travellers or good friends.

mirador.name: El Mirador
mirador.description: A double bed and a private balcony looking straight out over the peaks of Gredos. Clay-tiled floors, warm wood and the finest sunrise you'll ever remember.

alcoba.name: La Alcoba del Fuego
alcoba.description: Our most romantic suite: a fireplace, a hot tub and stone walls glowing by candlelight. Ideal for anniversaries and moments worth celebrating.

casa.name: The whole house
casa.description: All three rooms plus the living room with its fireplace, the kitchen, the garden and the barbecue. Up to six people, with the whole house to yourselves.

environment.title: Gredos, right on your doorstep
environment.subtitle: Nature at its purest. This is what's waiting for you the moment you step outside.

hiking.title: Hiking trails
hiking.desc: Trails for every level, from gentle strolls to the climb up to the Circo de Gredos and the Laguna Grande.

pools.title: Gorges and natural pools
pools.desc: Crystal-clear mountain waters for an unforgettable summer dip, just a few minutes from the house.

villages.title: Charming villages
villages.desc: Navaluenga and the villages of the Alberche valley: stone, quiet squares and plenty of history.

food.title: Mountain cuisine
food.desc: Local meats, beans from Barco, cheeses and homemade sweets. Real, honest flavours.

bikes.title: Bike routes
bikes.desc: We rent bikes so you can discover the valley on two wheels at your own pace.

stars.title: Starry skies
stars.desc: Far from the city, the nights in Gredos give you a sky you'll never forget.

gallery.title: A glimpse of El Rincón
gallery.subtitle: The house, the rooms and the landscape all around them.

contact.title: Shall we chat?
